features.name: Async failures
features.notes: Propagation of failures through futures is not implemented in this baseline.

features.name: Async function calls
features.notes: Native future-producing function calls are not implemented in this baseline.

features.name: Explicit await forces a pending argument
features.notes: Upstream await now calls Builtin.runtimeForce; ordinary user function calls may pass pending arguments onward. The separate native async work has not merged into this baseline.

features.name: Future value representation
features.notes: The merged baseline does not represent futures in the native language pipeline.

features.name: Implicit await on value use
features.notes: Future values are not resolved implicitly by this baseline. Upstream e76430be5 also carries pending reads inside containers and closure captures without waiting at construction.

features.name: Captured local values
features.notes: A closure retains the local values it references.

features.name: Let/in expressions
features.notes: A binding can have an explicit continuation expression.

features.name: Lexical shadowing
features.notes: Inner bindings can shadow outer names.

features.name: Local let bindings
features.notes: Bind a value for later expressions.

features.name: Module value declarations
features.notes: Module-scoped val declarations are checked.

features.name: Statement sequences
features.notes: Earlier statements must have Unit type; the final expression supplies the result.

features.name: Tuple destructuring bindings
features.notes: Bind several tuple elements, including nested patterns.

features.name: Unit binding patterns
features.notes: Match a Unit value in a binding.

features.name: Wildcard bindings
features.notes: Discard a binding with _.
